input.change_text: Fixed skill argument names containing regex metacharacters breaking argument substitution

output.subject: Skill argument names with regex metacharacters no longer break substitution
output.action_text: Upgrade Claude Code to 2.1.139 if any skill argument name contains regex metacharacters (`.`, `*`, `+`, `?`, `[`, `(`, `\`, etc.). Pre-fix, substitution would break — likely silently, producing wrong text in skill invocations.
